description: Template schema and empty array container for importing real theatre data. No invented entries.

itemFieldsDocumentation.name: Full official name of theatre (string, required)
itemFieldsDocumentation.image_url: Direct URL or Supabase storage path to theatre image (string, optional)
itemFieldsDocumentation.amenities: List of amenities e.g. ['4K Laser', 'Dolby Atmos', 'Recliner Seats', 'Wheelchair Accessible'] (array of strings, optional)
